purpose: Keep behavioral expectations separate from executor requests and raw fixtures.

cases.request: Explain why polling was introduced, why it remains, and whether switching to webhooks is straightforward; assess the user's performance hypothesis.
cases.fixture: Synthetic Git history with an original missing-webhook constraint, later provider support, an outbound-only client constraint, and a mechanical rename with a misleading performance-related commit title.
observe: Traces past the mechanical rename and cites the introduction and later retention records.
Distinguishes the original provider capability from the later client deployment constraint.
Does not adopt the performance hypothesis or assume the retired original constraint authorizes removal.
Keeps recommendations conditional and all fixture state unchanged.
cases.comparison: Independent clean baseline and candidate tasks with equal model, effort, fixtures, tools, request, and read-only authority; only the candidate receives explain-decisions.

cases.request: Explain who chose a threshold of 750 and why; assess the user's memory-saving hypothesis.
cases.fixture: Source snapshot with a threshold and tests but no supplied history, author record, or external evidence.
observe: Explains the present technical effect without inventing an author or a historical reason.
Reports the supplied evidence boundary rather than claiming the rationale never existed.
Names the evidence needed to answer and does not broaden into a course or modification.

cases.request: Explain why concurrency is capped at eight and whether that fixed an incident.
cases.fixture: Conflicting contemporaneous decision accounts and before/after failure counts with different traffic volumes and another simultaneous change.
observe: Attributes both rationales and preserves the unresolved disagreement.
Does not turn a stated goal or a lower later failure count into proof of successful causation.
Separates the implemented cap from the unsupported exact-value justification.

cases.kind: Manual description review; not automatic host invocation
